resources.string: Photograph your own wall, mark its holds and set climbs on it. A wall stays on this phone unless you make it public.
Private walls stay on this phone. Spray walls are not included in Android backups; your logbook is never published.
Photo of the wall with its holds
Take the photo straight on, with the whole wall in the picture and even light.

Pick a photo of the wall first.
The angle is logged with every ascent.
This removes the photo, all holds, climbs and their logbook entries from this phone. It can\'t be undone.
The wall is also withdrawn from Nostr and its photos are deleted from the Blossom servers; copies others already have can stay.

Tap a hold to pick it, drag it to move it and use the slider to size it. Press and hold the wall to add a hold, or switch on Add to place several in a row. Dashed rings are suggestions: tap one to take it. Pinch to zoom.
Tap a hold to change its size or remove it.

Pick a role, then tap holds. Tap a hold again to take it off the climb.

The photo is shrunk and stored without camera data (place, device). It stays on this phone.
The photo is shrunk and stored without camera data (place, device). This wall is public: the new photo is published with it, so it must not show people.
Drag the corners or edges to crop to the wall. Turn the photo until the wall stands upright.

The holds of %1$s were taken down and set again? Take a new photo of the wall. Its holds start fresh; the climbs set so far stay with the old photo under \"Earlier\", and the old state can be restored at any time under Versions.
The new photo has no holds yet. Mark them now, or discard the reset to go back to the previous state of the wall.
No open suggestions. More sensitive shows less sure ones.
Orange outlines are suggestions. Tap one to take it, or take all. More sensitive shows more, including doubtful ones.
No holds found. Mark them by hand: press and hold the wall, or switch on Add.
Download the hold model once (33 MB). It finds holds of every colour with their real shape and then runs on this phone without internet. You can remove it again in Settings under Delete local data.
The download did not work. Check the connection and try again.
Downloaded for hold finding on spray walls. Without it the simpler detector suggests holds; it can be downloaded again at any time.
Looking for holds did not work on this photo. Mark them by hand.
The hold model could not run on this photo. These suggestions come from the simpler detector.

resources.string: Holds saved as a new version. Climbs that use a removed hold keep it, drawn dashed.
Every saved change of the holds, every reset with a new photo and every restore is kept as a version. Tap a version to see it.
Its photo and holds become the wall\'s current state again, as a new version. Nothing is deleted: the versions in between stay in the list.
Set before the wall was reset. It is shown on the photo it was set on.
Only on this phone. Nothing about it is published.
Published over Nostr with your CruxCoach account: the photo of every version, the holds and the climbs. Others can add the wall and set climbs on it. Your logbook stays private.

The photo of every version of this wall, its holds and the climbs on it become public under your CruxCoach account. You can withdraw the wall later, but copies others already have can stay. Your logbook is never published.
The photos must not show people.
Publishing a wall needs your CruxCoach account key. Set it up in Settings under CruxCoach Account, then make the wall public.
This wall is not published yet: no connection to the relays or the photo server. Try again later.

Relays are asked to delete the wall, all its versions and your climbs on it, and its photos are deleted from the Blossom servers they were uploaded to. Copies others already have can stay. The wall stays on this phone as a private wall.
No relay confirmed the withdrawal, so the wall is still public. Check the connection and try again.
The relays took the withdrawal, but a photo could not be deleted from its Blossom server, so the wall stays public here. Check the connection and try again.
Signing did not work or was declined in your signer app, so the wall is still public. Try again and confirm the requests.
Withdrawing needs the CruxCoach account key the wall was published with. Set it up in Settings under CruxCoach Account, then try again.
A public wall is deleted here only once it is withdrawn.
